scoring_justification: Checker recomputes the agreement metric as fraction of boundary points within tolerance compared to hidden digitized reference points from Figure 8.

schema.description: Each row represents a temperature where a miscibility gap exists. x_maj_low and x_maj_high are the Fe-poor and Fe-rich phase boundaries (0 < x < 1).

outputs.description: Final scored artifact: the miscibility gap phase boundaries at 0 GPa, derived from free-energy isotherms. Checker compares these boundaries to hidden reference points digitized from the paper’s Figure 8, with tolerance in mole fraction and temperature.

output_contract.notes: The intermediate mc_enthalpies.csv and free_energy_isotherms.csv are process evidence and are not scored. Only the gap boundaries are in the output contract.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference miscibility gap boundary points at 0 GPa digitized from Figure 8 of the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Digitized from Figure 8 (solid black curve) of the published paper
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manual digitization from the published figure; points correspond to the curve shown at 0 GPa.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact digitized coordinates from the paper's result; they are consistent with the statement that the gap starts at ~3500 K and x_maj~0.8, and with the oracle solve.sh reference which matches them. No fabrication.
